stage: S7.8 - utility and qualification rule operationalization

operational_resolutions.OR-01: canonical support id parsed at parenthesis depth 0; registry support_size is the mandatory checksum
operational_resolutions.OR-02: E_fit is pairwise against the Rank-1 best, not a transitive class
operational_resolutions.OR-03: BLOCK_WORST paired SE uses each candidate's own worst block; identity verified; the 0.01-only fallback is NOT_REQUIRED
operational_resolutions.OR-04: percentile estimator frozen as numpy.percentile method='linear'
operational_resolutions.OR-05: ACTIVE_TERMS counts columns non-zero in at least one of the 60 calibration fits
operational_resolutions.OR-06: conditioning rows are the cell calibration rows; standardization makes centred and standardized readings coincide
operational_resolutions.OR-07: kappa from SVD, never the normal-equation square; sigma_min == 0 gives +inf
operational_resolutions.OR-08: Rank-4 winner is the canonical-first element of E4
operational_resolutions.OR-09: bootstrap multiplicities weight every discharge-level aggregation; blocks are never resampled
operational_resolutions.OR-10: fold perturbation aggregates over the two remaining blocks, 40 cells
operational_resolutions.OR-11: a non-finite cell gives FIT = +inf and exclusion from E_fit, never inadmissibility
operational_resolutions.OR-12: the 1000-replicate Rank-5 bootstrap is distinct from the >=10000-replicate S7.10 gate-inference bootstrap; both stand

qualifications: The Rank-2 BLOCK_WORST practical-equivalence rule required an operational paired-SE definition. A discretion-free one was found and verified (mean_s d_s = BLOCK_WORST(A) - BLOCK_WORST(B) exactly, max deviation 2.67e-16), so the instruction's permitted fallback to a 0.01-only floor was NOT invoked and no new tunable threshold was introduced.

The canonical support_id cannot be parsed by splitting on the pipe character: C4/C6/C7/C8 signatures embed a pipe inside their own parentheses and a naive split mis-parses 116608 of 162845 rows (71.6 percent). A depth-aware parse plus a mandatory support_size checksum is frozen. S7.9 must run the checksum before computing anything.

ACTIVE_TERMS required a candidate-level aggregation rule because OLS coefficients are discharge/block local. The union rule (non-zero in at least one of the 60 calibration fits) was frozen as the conservative, threshold-free reading; under full-rank OLS it is expected to be non-binding.
Executability was demonstrated on a synthetic fixture rather than on Ahat_rec, so that S7.8 could prove the algorithm runs without performing any part of the S7.9 computation.
